prompt:

Create ONE finished square Swedish vocabulary artwork for an adult mobile flashcard app. Use the Finnish iOS card style: vivid tactile realistic editorial illustration, memorable scale and clear action, warm light, cream header with fine gold edging, bold navy typography, integrated cream/gold memory-link caption, pale blue bottom example strip. Header text verbatim: "en rutin". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "routine".
Scene: An adult making morning coffee, simple recurring sequence of cup icons on several identical day squares nearby, no dates or added words.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "rutin resembles routine; a usual repeated way of doing things.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Morgonkaffet är en del av min rutin.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
